title: Minesweet
description: Minesweeper with a twist: send a friend the exact same board and try to beat their time, then hit Revenge. Play a Daily Duel that is the same for everyone, keep your streak, and attach sabotage cards like Blackout and Time Attack to your challenges. Beginner, Intermediate and Expert with leaderboards. Tap to dig, long-press or right-click to flag.
